prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1096; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This is a recorded statement regarding the parking lot incident in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were seated at the time of the collision.

A: I was in the front passenger seat of the vehicle. My friend was driving.

Q: Can you describe what was happening right before the impact?

A: We were pulling into a parking space near the store entrance. A car backing out from the next row didn't stop, and it hit the driver's side of our vehicle pretty hard.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, not really. I was looking at my phone to check a message. I only saw it when the noise happened.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?

A: We were going very slowly, maybe a walking pace. We were basically stopped at the time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I had it on.

Q: Tell me about your injuries.

A: My right shoulder hit the door and the side window when we were thrown toward that side. I felt sharp pain right away and I have had trouble lifting my arm since then. I went to urgent care that same afternoon.

Q: Have you seen any doctors or therapists since then?

A: Yes, I have been to a physical therapist twice a week, and I have an appointment with an orthopedic doctor next week for a possible MRI.

Q: Did you have any shoulder problems before this collision?

A: No, my shoulder had been fine. I play recreational softball, but I had no treatment or pain before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I want my medical bills and lost work time covered. I have been unable to do my usual job duties while my arm is healing.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
